prepaidServices.subtitle: Pre-Paid Service Charges
prepaidServices.hoverDescription: Pay all daily service charges before you embark for convenient budget planning and additional freedom onboard.
prepaidServices.title: Pre-Paid Service Charges
prepaidServices.optInLabel: I want to pre-pay my service charges
prepaidServices.description: The convenience of pre-paying service charges allows you to plan your budget prior to your cruise giving you additional freedom while on board. A discretionary charge of $20 USD per person per day for all guests 3 years or older will automatically be added to your onboard account. Your service charges will total $120 USD for all guests, for your entire cruise. Guests sailing to Hawaii will be charged an additional 4.275% Pre Paid Service Charge GET Tax.
